chapters.title: Welcome Unit 初高中衔接
chapters.summary: 衔接初高中英语，复习基本句型结构、学习策略与校园生活词汇。

knowledge.title: 五大基本句型
knowledge.content: ①S+V（主谓）②S+V+O（主谓宾）③S+V+IO+DO（主谓双宾）④S+V+O+C（主谓宾补）⑤S+V+P（主系表）。分析句子先找谓语动词，再判断结构。

knowledge.title: 校园生活词汇
knowledge.content: campus 校园, lecture 讲座, registration 注册, dormitory 宿舍, exchange 交流, strategy 策略, flashcard 抽认卡, take notes 记笔记, concentrate on 专注。

knowledge.title: 学习策略
knowledge.content: 扩大词汇量（构词法、语境记忆）；坚持听说读写训练；建立错题本；用英语记日记；利用词典与语料。

exam_points.title: 句型分析
exam_points.content: 判断句子结构，划分句子成分（主谓宾定状补表）。

exam_points.title: 词义推断
exam_points.content: 阅读中通过构词法、上下文、同义反义推断生词含义。

examples.title: 句型判断
examples.question: 指出 "She bought me a dictionary." 的句型。
examples.analysis: bought 为谓语，me 为间接宾语，a dictionary 为直接宾语。

chapters.title: Unit 1 Teenage Life 青少年生活
chapters.summary: 话题：青少年生活与课外活动。语法：复习时态。写作：建议信。

knowledge.title: 重点词汇
knowledge.content: volunteer 志愿者, debate 辩论, prefer 更喜欢, suitable 合适的, challenge 挑战, schedule 日程, quit 放弃, responsible 负责任的, generation 一代人, attract 吸引, focus 集中, advance 进步。

knowledge.title: 重点短语
knowledge.content: prefer...to... 喜欢……胜过……, sign up for 报名参加, be suitable for 适合, focus on 集中于, be responsible for 对……负责, hand out 分发, be addicted to 沉迷于, get used to 习惯于。

knowledge.title: 核心句型
knowledge.content: ①I prefer... to... ②The reason why... is that... ③It is + adj. + for sb. to do sth. ④You'd better (not) do...（表建议）。

knowledge.title: 语法：复习时态
knowledge.content: 一般现在时表习惯真理；一般过去时表过去事实；现在进行时表进行；现在完成时表过去动作对现在的影响；一般将来时表将来。注意时间状语搭配与主从句时态呼应。

exam_points.title: 词汇与短语
exam_points.content: prefer/preference 词形变化；be addicted to 后接动名词；focus 与 concentrate 辨析。

exam_points.title: 时态
exam_points.content: 依据语境与时间状语选择正确时态，注意主从句时态一致。

exam_points.title: 建议信写作
exam_points.content: 格式（称呼、正文、结尾）；常用句式 I suggest/recommend that..., It is advisable to..., Why not...?。

examples.title: 时态选择
examples.question: 用适当形式填空：He ______ (join) the chess club last term and ______ (be) a member ever since.
examples.analysis: 前句 last term 用一般过去时；后句 ever since 提示现在完成时。

examples.title: 建议句式
examples.question: 翻译：我建议你报名参加辩论社。
examples.analysis: suggest 后从句用 (should)+动词原形。
examples.answer: I suggest that you (should) sign up for the debate club.

chapters.title: Unit 2 Travelling Around 旅游
chapters.summary: 话题：旅游与目的地。语法：现在进行时表将来。写作：旅行计划/游记。

knowledge.title: 重点词汇
knowledge.content: destination 目的地, amazing 令人惊叹的, ancient 古老的, narrow 狭窄的, flight 航班, accommodation 住宿, unique 独特的, official 官方的, emperor 皇帝, site 遗址, economy 经济。

knowledge.title: 重点短语
knowledge.content: apply for 申请, take control of 控制, other than 除了, make up 构成/编造, check in 办理登记, check out 结账离开, be famous for 因……著名, package tour 跟团游。

knowledge.title: 核心句型
knowledge.content: ①be doing sth. 表按计划即将发生 ②It is amazing that... ③主语 + be + to do（表计划安排）。

knowledge.title: 语法：现在进行时表将来
knowledge.content: come, go, arrive, leave, start, fly, travel 等位移动词的现在进行时可表示按计划即将发生的动作。如 I am leaving for Beijing tomorrow.

exam_points.title: 现在进行时表将来
exam_points.content: 位移动词进行时表将来；与 be going to / be to do 的区别。

exam_points.title: 词汇运用
exam_points.content: amaze/amazed/amazing 辨析（-ing 修饰物，-ed 修饰人）；apply/application 词族。

exam_points.title: 旅行计划写作
exam_points.content: 用现在进行时描述行程，条理清晰，包含交通、住宿、景点。

examples.title: 语法填空
examples.question: My flight ______ (take off) at 9:00 tomorrow morning.
examples.analysis: 位移动词 take off 进行时表按计划将来。

examples.title: 词形辨析
examples.question: 用 amaze 适当形式填空：The view was ______ and we were ______ at it.
examples.analysis: amazing 修饰物，amazed 修饰人。

chapters.title: Unit 3 Sports and Fitness 运动与健康
chapters.summary: 话题：体育运动与健康生活。语法：反意疑问句。写作：健康生活方式比较。

knowledge.title: 重点词汇
knowledge.content: fitness 健康, champion 冠军, determine 决心, injured 受伤的, captain 队长, graceful 优雅的, strength 力量, failure 失败, compete 竞争, pretend 假装, diet 饮食, balanced 平衡的。

knowledge.title: 重点短语
knowledge.content: make it 成功/赶到, work out 锻炼, give up 放弃, lose weight 减肥, rather than 而不是, cut out 戒除, compare...to... 把……比作, make a difference 起作用。

knowledge.title: 核心句型
knowledge.content: ①Instead of doing..., sb. does... ②The more..., the more... ③It is up to sb. to do sth.。

knowledge.title: 语法：反意疑问句
knowledge.content: 前肯后否、前否后肯；be/助/情态动词与主句一致。特殊情况：let's 用 shall we；祈使句用 will you；nothing/nobody 等否定词后用肯定；I think/believe 后反问与从句主语一致。

exam_points.title: 反意疑问句
exam_points.content: 依据主句谓语与否定词确定反问部分；特殊句型（let's, 祈使, 主从复合句）的用法。

exam_points.title: 词汇辨析
exam_points.content: compete/competition/competitive；injure/wound/hurt。

exam_points.title: 健康话题写作
exam_points.content: 比较不同生活方式，提出建议，结构对比清晰。

examples.title: 反意疑问句
examples.question: 完成反意疑问句：He has never been to the gym, ______?
examples.analysis: 前句有 never 否定词，反问部分用肯定；谓语 has 为助动词。

examples.title: 句型翻译
examples.question: 翻译：你锻炼得越多，就越健康。
examples.analysis: 用 The more..., the more... 句型。
examples.answer: The more you work out, the healthier you will be.

chapters.title: Unit 4 Natural Disasters 自然灾害
chapters.summary: 话题：自然灾害与救援。语法：限制性定语从句（关系代词）。写作：灾害报道/新闻报道。

knowledge.title: 重点词汇
knowledge.content: disaster 灾难, earthquake 地震, rescue 救援, shelter 庇护所, survive 幸存, destroy 破坏, affect 影响, effort 努力, emergency 紧急情况, supply 供应, summary 摘要, significant 重大的。

knowledge.title: 重点短语
knowledge.content: in ruins 严重受损, as if 仿佛, come to an end 结束, in shock 震惊, dig out 掘出, sweep away 冲走, suffer from 遭受, provide sth. for sb. 为某人提供某物。

knowledge.title: 核心句型
knowledge.content: ①It seemed as if... ②There were... doing sth. ③The number of... who/which...（定语从句）。

knowledge.title: 语法：限制性定语从句（关系代词）
knowledge.content: who 指人作主/宾，whom 指人作宾，which 指物，that 指人或物，whose 表所属（人/物均可）。作宾语可省略。that 与 which 区别：只用 that 的情况（最高级、序数词修饰、不定代词先行词、人和物并列先行词等）。

exam_points.title: 定语从句关系代词
exam_points.content: 选用正确关系代词；that 与 which 的辨析；whose 的用法。

exam_points.title: 词汇运用
exam_points.content: destroy/ruin/damage 辨析；survive/survival/survivor 词族。

exam_points.title: 新闻写作
exam_points.content: 新闻要素（when/where/who/what/why/how）；语言客观简洁。

examples.title: 定语从句
examples.question: 用关系代词填空：The earthquake ______ struck the city caused great damage.
examples.analysis: 先行词 earthquake 指物，在从句中作主语，可用 that 或 which。

examples.title: that 与 which
examples.question: This is the most terrible disaster ______ I have ever experienced.（填关系代词）
examples.analysis: 先行词被最高级修饰，只用 that。

chapters.title: Unit 5 Languages Around the World 世界语言
chapters.summary: 话题：世界语言与汉字发展。语法：限制性定语从句（关系副词与介词+关系代词）。写作：语言学习经验。

knowledge.title: 重点词汇
knowledge.content: symbol 符号, classic 经典的, regard 看作, variety 多样性, major 主要的, native 本地的, attitude 态度, official 官方的, appreciate 欣赏, demand 要求, vocabulary 词汇。

knowledge.title: 重点短语
knowledge.content: regard...as... 把……看作, refer to 指的是/提到, date back to 追溯到, be based on 基于, no matter 不管, point of view 观点, depend on 依赖。

knowledge.title: 核心句型
knowledge.content: ①even though/if 即使 ②no matter + 疑问词 ③the way (in which/that) + 定语从句。

knowledge.title: 语法：关系副词与介词+关系代词
knowledge.content: when 表时间 (=at/in/on which)，where 表地点 (=in/at which)，why 表原因 (=for which)。介词+which/whom：根据动词搭配或先行词确定介词。关系副词可用 that 替换，作状语不可省略。

exam_points.title: 关系副词
exam_points.content: 区分关系代词与关系副词（看在从句中作主宾还是状语）；when/where/why 的选用。

exam_points.title: 介词+关系代词
exam_points.content: 根据搭配确定介词；which 指物 whom 指人。

exam_points.title: 词汇与句型
exam_points.content: no matter 与 however 的转换；regard...as...。

examples.title: 关系副词
examples.question: 填空：This is the school ______ I studied for three years.
examples.analysis: 先行词 school 表地点，从句缺地点状语，用 where。

examples.title: 介词+关系代词
examples.question: 填空：The person ______ ______ I talked is our English teacher.
examples.analysis: talk to sb. 搭配，介词用 to，指人用 whom。

chapters.title: Unit 1 Cultural Heritage 文化遗产
chapters.summary: 话题：文化遗产保护（以阿斯旺大坝神庙搬迁为例）。语法：限制性定语从句（复习）。写作：保护文化遗产倡议。

knowledge.title: 重点词汇
knowledge.content: heritage 遗产, temple 寺庙, preserve 保护, promote 促进, balance 平衡, protest 抗议, committee 委员会, establish 建立, limit 限制, conduct 进行, document 文件/记录。

knowledge.title: 重点短语
knowledge.content: give way to 让步于, turn to 求助于, take apart 拆开, piece by piece 一块块地, contribute to 有助于, be likely to 可能, in turn 依次。

knowledge.title: 核心句型
knowledge.content: ①Not only...but also...（部分倒装） ②There comes a time when... ③It is worthwhile to do...。

knowledge.title: 语法：定语从句复习
knowledge.content: 综合运用关系代词与关系副词；非限制性定语从句初步认识（用逗号隔开，补充说明，不可用 that）。

exam_points.title: 定语从句综合
exam_points.content: 限制性与非限制性定语从句辨析；关系词选用与省略。

exam_points.title: 倒装句
exam_points.content: not only...but also 置于句首引起部分倒装。

exam_points.title: 应用文写作
exam_points.content: 倡议书结构与呼吁句式。

examples.title: 倒装
examples.question: 用倒装改写：Not only ______ ______ (he/protect) the temple, but he also raised funds.
examples.analysis: Not only 置于句首，主句部分倒装，用助动词 did。

chapters.title: Unit 2 Wildlife Protection 野生动植物保护
chapters.summary: 话题：野生动植物保护。语法：现在进行时的被动语态。写作：保护动物短文。

knowledge.title: 重点词汇
knowledge.content: wildlife 野生动物, species 物种, endangered 濒危的, habitat 栖息地, reserve 保护区, adapt 适应, exist 存在, attack 攻击, recover 恢复, concern 担忧, harmony 和谐。

knowledge.title: 重点短语
knowledge.content: die out 灭绝, be concerned about 关心, adapt to 适应, under pressure 在压力下, be aware of 意识到, on average 平均, make progress 取得进步。

knowledge.title: 核心句型
knowledge.content: ①...is being done（正在进行被动） ②It is high time that sb. did sth. ③Only by doing... can we...（部分倒装）。

knowledge.title: 语法：现在进行时被动语态
knowledge.content: 结构 am/is/are + being + 过去分词，表示正在被进行的动作。如 The bridge is being built now. 注意：being 不可遗漏。

exam_points.title: 现在进行时被动
exam_points.content: 结构辨析与填空；与一般现在时被动、现在完成时被动的区别。

exam_points.title: 词汇
exam_points.content: adapt/adopt 辨析；die out/die of/die from 区别。

exam_points.title: 倒装
exam_points.content: only + 状语前置的部分倒装。

examples.title: 被动语态
examples.question: 填空：The old church ______ ______ ______ (repair) at present.
examples.analysis: at present 提示现在进行，主语被修用被动。

examples.title: 倒装
examples.question: 改写：Only by working together ______ ______ (we/save) these animals.
examples.analysis: Only+状语前置引起部分倒装。

chapters.title: Unit 3 The Internet 互联网
chapters.summary: 话题：互联网与生活。语法：现在完成时的被动语态。写作：网络利弊议论文。

knowledge.title: 重点词汇
knowledge.content: convenient 方便的, benefit 利益, privacy 隐私, identity 身份, update 更新, confirm 确认, distance 距离, addicted 上瘾的, battery 电池, discount 折扣。

knowledge.title: 重点短语
knowledge.content: keep track of 跟踪, keep sb. company 陪伴, now that 既然, have access to 有权使用, in shape 状况良好, belong to 属于。

knowledge.title: 核心句型
knowledge.content: ①...has/have been done（现在完成被动） ②It is the first time that...has/have done ③so...that...。

knowledge.title: 语法：现在完成时被动语态
knowledge.content: 结构 has/have + been + 过去分词，表示过去已完成且对现在有影响的被动动作。如 The work has been finished.

exam_points.title: 现在完成时被动
exam_points.content: 结构辨析；与一般过去时被动的区别（看是否对现在有影响）。

exam_points.title: 议论文写作
exam_points.content: 利弊分析结构：引出话题—利—弊—结论；连接词 however, on the other hand, in addition。

exam_points.title: 词汇辨析
exam_points.content: benefit from/by；convenient 不能以人作主语。

examples.title: 被动语态
examples.question: 填空：All the tickets ______ ______ ______ (sell) online so far.
examples.analysis: so far 提示现在完成，tickets 被售用被动。

examples.title: 时态句型
examples.question: 翻译：这是我第一次参观故宫。
examples.analysis: It is the first time that... 后用现在完成时。
examples.answer: It is the first time that I have visited the Palace Museum.

chapters.title: Unit 4 History and Traditions 历史与传统
chapters.summary: 话题：英国历史与传统文化。语法：过去分词作定语和宾补。写作：地点/景点介绍。

knowledge.title: 重点词汇
knowledge.content: ancestor 祖先, philosopher 哲学家, individual 个人, belong 属于, evidence 证据, achieve 达到, generous 慷慨的, position 位置, fascinating 迷人的, landscape 风景。

knowledge.title: 重点短语
knowledge.content: belong to 属于, as well as 也, be proud of 以……为豪, break away from 脱离, result in 导致, leave behind 留下。

knowledge.title: 核心句型
knowledge.content: ①过去分词短语作后置定语 ②have/get sth. done ③with + 宾语 + 过去分词（宾补）。

knowledge.title: 语法：过去分词作定语与宾补
knowledge.content: 作定语：单个词前置（fallen leaves 落叶），短语后置（the book written by him）；及物动词过去分词表被动完成。作宾补：have/get sth. done（使某事被做），表状态或被动。

exam_points.title: 过去分词作定语
exam_points.content: 区分现在分词与过去分词作定语（主动进行 vs 被动完成）；位置。

exam_points.title: 过去分词作宾补
exam_points.content: have/get sth. done 结构；与 doing 宾补的区别。

exam_points.title: 地点介绍写作
exam_points.content: 位置、历史、特色、感受；现在/过去分词丰富表达。

examples.title: 过去分词作定语
examples.question: 填空：The building ______ (build) in 1900 is still in use.
examples.analysis: build 与 building 为被动关系，且已完成，用过去分词。

examples.title: 宾补结构
examples.question: 翻译：我昨天让人修了电脑。
examples.analysis: have sth. done 表使某事被做。
examples.answer: I had the computer repaired yesterday.

chapters.title: Unit 5 Music 音乐
chapters.summary: 话题：音乐与虚拟合唱团。语法：过去分词作状语。写作：音乐的影响短文。

knowledge.title: 重点词汇
knowledge.content: perform 表演, stage 舞台, award 奖项, composition 作品, capable 有能力的, phenomenon 现象, treatment 治疗, relief 缓解, thus 因此, equipment 设备。

knowledge.title: 重点短语
knowledge.content: fall in love with 爱上, be capable of 能够, in addition to 除……之外, take part in 参加, come up with 想出, from then on 从那时起。

knowledge.title: 核心句型
knowledge.content: ①过去分词作状语（时间/原因/条件/让步） ②It is said that... ③Not only...but also...。

knowledge.title: 语法：过去分词作状语
knowledge.content: 过去分词作状语表被动、完成，逻辑主语与主句主语一致。如 Given more time, I could do better. 否定用 Not given。注意与现在分词作状语区分（主动 vs 被动）。

exam_points.title: 过去分词作状语
exam_points.content: 判断分词与主语关系选 doing/done；分词作状语的否定与位置。

exam_points.title: 词汇
exam_points.content: perform/performance；award/reward 辨析。

exam_points.title: 写作
exam_points.content: 用分词状语使句式多样。

examples.title: 分词作状语
examples.question: 填空：______ (give) another chance, he would succeed.
examples.analysis: give 与 he 为被动关系，作条件状语用过去分词。

examples.title: 分词选择
examples.question: 填空：______ (face) with difficulties, she didn't give up.
examples.analysis: be faced with 固定搭配，作状语用 faced。

chapters.title: Unit 1 Festivals and Celebrations 节日
chapters.summary: 话题：世界节日与庆祝。语法：情态动词。写作：节日介绍。

knowledge.title: 重点词汇
knowledge.content: festival 节日, celebrate 庆祝, origin 起源, religious 宗教的, custom 习俗, gather 聚集, feast 盛宴, gratitude 感激, joy 喜悦, decorate 装饰, symbol 象征。

knowledge.title: 重点短语
knowledge.content: in spite of 尽管, range from...to... 范围从……到……, dress up 打扮, after all 毕竟, be grateful for 感激, figure out 弄明白。

knowledge.title: 核心句型
knowledge.content: ①情态动词表能力、许可、必须、建议 ②No matter how... ③It is a time when...。

knowledge.title: 语法：情态动词
knowledge.content: can/could 表能力或许可；may/might 表许可或推测；must 表必须（否定 needn't 不必）；should/ought to 表建议；shall 表征求意见或命令；will/would 表意愿。推测：must be 一定是，can't be 不可能是。

exam_points.title: 情态动词
exam_points.content: 基本用法与辨析；表推测的用法（must/can't/may）；must 与 have to 的区别。

exam_points.title: 词汇
exam_points.content: celebrate/celebration；custom/habit 辨析。

exam_points.title: 节日介绍写作
exam_points.content: 时间、起源、活动、意义。

examples.title: 情态动词
examples.question: 填空：You ______ not park here; it's forbidden.
examples.analysis: 禁止停车，表必须不，用 must。

examples.title: 推测
examples.question: 改写：I'm sure he is the thief. → He ______ be the thief.
examples.analysis: 肯定推测用 must。

chapters.title: Unit 2 Morals and Virtues 道德与美德
chapters.summary: 话题：道德困境与美德（以林巧稚为例）。语法：情态动词表推测。写作：美德故事/观点。

knowledge.title: 重点词汇
knowledge.content: moral 道德的, virtue 美德, dilemma 困境, faint 晕倒, complain 抱怨, respond 回应, reject 拒绝, tend 照顾, retire 退休, principle 原则, significant 重要的。

knowledge.title: 重点短语
knowledge.content: carry sb. through 帮某人渡过难关, in trouble 处于困境, be known for 因……闻名, first aid 急救, in despair 绝望, be responsible for 对……负责。

knowledge.title: 核心句型
knowledge.content: ①情态动词表推测（must/may/might/can't + do/be doing/have done） ②It is worthwhile to do... ③Rather than..., sb. did...。

knowledge.title: 语法：情态动词表推测
knowledge.content: 肯定推测 must（一定）、may/might（可能）；否定推测 can't（不可能）。对现在推测 + do/be doing，对过去推测 + have done。如 He must have finished it yesterday.

exam_points.title: 情态动词表推测
exam_points.content: 依据肯定/否定选 must/can't/may；时态搭配（have done 表过去）。

exam_points.title: 词汇
exam_points.content: respond/response；reject/refuse 辨析。

exam_points.title: 写作
exam_points.content: 叙述美德故事，夹叙夹议。

examples.title: 推测过去
examples.question: 填空：The ground is wet. It ______ ______ rained last night.
examples.analysis: 对过去肯定推测用 must have done。

examples.title: 否定推测
examples.question: 填空：He ______ be at home; I just saw him at school.

chapters.title: Unit 3 Diverse Cultures 多元文化
chapters.summary: 话题：多元文化（以旧金山为例）。语法：it 的用法。写作：城市/文化介绍。

knowledge.title: 重点词汇
knowledge.content: diverse 多样的, fortune 财富, immigrant 移民, contain 包含, district 地区, material 材料, construction 建设, definitely 肯定地, historical 历史的, diverse 不同的。

knowledge.title: 重点短语
knowledge.content: head to 前往, seek one's fortune 寻找发财机会, a variety of 各种, bring about 引起, apart from 除了, settle in 定居于。

knowledge.title: 核心句型
knowledge.content: ①It is + adj./n. + that... ②It takes sb. time to do... ③It is... that...（强调句）。

knowledge.title: 语法：it 的用法
knowledge.content: it 作形式主语（It is said that...）、形式宾语（find it hard to...）；强调句 It is/was + 强调部分 + that...；指代时间、天气、距离。判断强调句：去掉 It is/was...that 后句子仍完整。

exam_points.title: it 用法
exam_points.content: 形式主语/宾语；强调句判断与改写；与定语从句区分。

exam_points.title: 词汇
exam_points.content: diverse/diversity；contain/include 辨析。

exam_points.title: 文化介绍写作
exam_points.content: 特点、成因、表现、感受。

examples.title: 强调句
examples.question: 对画线部分强调：I met Tom in the park yesterday.（强调 in the park）
examples.分析: 强调句结构 It is/was + 强调部分 + that + 其余。
examples.answer: It was in the park that I met Tom yesterday.

examples.title: 形式宾语
examples.question: 填空：I find ______ important to learn English well.
examples.分析: it 作形式宾语，真正宾语为 to do。

chapters.title: Unit 4 Space Exploration 太空探索
chapters.summary: 话题：太空探索历程。语法：不定式。写作：太空探索意义议论文。

knowledge.title: 重点词汇
knowledge.content: explore 探索, launch 发射, astronaut 宇航员, signal 信号, intelligent 智能的, determine 决心, independent 独立的, limited 有限的, vital 至关重要的, mystery 谜。

knowledge.title: 重点短语
knowledge.content: carry on 继续, on board 在船上/机上, as a result 结果, provide for 供养, in closing 最后, run out 用完。

knowledge.title: 核心句型
knowledge.content: ①It is + adj. + for sb. to do ②To do... is...（不定式作主语） ③so as to / in order to 表目的。

knowledge.title: 语法：不定式
knowledge.content: 不定式作主语（常以 it 作形式主语）、宾语、表语、定语（表将来）、状语（表目的、结果）。否定 not to do。注意：decide/hope/plan + to do；make up one's mind to do。

exam_points.title: 不定式
exam_points.content: 作各成分的辨析；不定式作定语与状语；to do 与 doing 区别。

exam_points.title: 词汇
exam_points.content: explore/exploration；determined/determine。

exam_points.title: 议论文写作
exam_points.content: 明确观点，论据充分，逻辑清晰。

examples.title: 不定式作主语
examples.question: 改写：To master a language is necessary. → It is necessary ______.
examples.分析: it 作形式主语，不定式后置。

examples.title: 不定式作目的状语
examples.question: 翻译：他早起是为了赶上首班车。
examples.answer: He got up early to catch the first bus.

chapters.title: Unit 5 The Value of Money 金钱的价值
chapters.summary: 话题：金钱的价值（以《百万英镑》为例）。语法：复习情态动词与不定式。写作：金钱观讨论/剧本片段。

knowledge.title: 重点词汇
knowledge.content: value 价值, basis 基础, apologise 道歉, spot 发现, patience 耐心, manner 方式/礼貌, permission 允许, indeed 确实, hesitate 犹豫, reserve 预订。

knowledge.title: 重点短语
knowledge.content: as a matter of fact 事实上, on the basis of 在……基础上, take out a loan 贷款, in return 作为回报, be about to do 即将做, to be honest 老实说。

knowledge.title: 核心句型
knowledge.content: ①be about to do... when... ②It is up to sb. to do ③情态动词 + have done（表对过去的推测或责备）。

knowledge.title: 语法：复习情态动词与不定式
knowledge.content: should have done 本该做却没做；ought to have done；could have done 本可以做；needn't have done 本不必做。不定式综合运用。

exam_points.title: 情态动词+have done
exam_points.content: 表责备/推测/虚拟的辨析；should/could/needn't have done。

exam_points.title: 词汇
exam_points.content: value/valuable；manner(s) 单复数含义。

exam_points.title: 写作
exam_points.content: 金钱观议论；剧本对白格式。

examples.title: 情态动词+have done
examples.question: 填空：You ______ ______ (not/hurry); we still have plenty of time.
examples.分析: 本不必做用 needn't have done。

examples.title: 句型
examples.question: 翻译：我刚要出门，这时电话响了。
examples.分析: be about to do... when... 句型。
examples.answer: I was about to go out when the phone rang.
